shloka.text: बुद्धं शरणं गच्छामि • धर्मं शरणं गच्छामि • संघं शरणं गच्छामि • सब्बदा सोत्थि भवन्तु ते
shloka.translation: May the supreme wisdom of the Buddha, the righteous path of Dhamma, and the harmonious Sangha protect, enlighten, and bless this matrimonial bond with peace and prosperity.
